title: Mission: The Snail
subtitle: A little crawler with a spiral shell
summary: Meet a snail in 3D, find its shell, tentacles and foot, then help it crawl along a damp garden path.
activityLabel: Crawl and build the snail picture
activityInstruction: Activity 1: Choose the damp path, crawl five steps, then Rest. Activity 2: Tap two picture tiles to swap them and rebuild the snail.
exploreInstruction: Turn and zoom the snail. Play its movement, then pause to look closely at its spiral shell, tentacles and broad foot.

storyQuestions.prompt: Does the animal move fast or slow?

parts.label: Shell
parts.fact: The hard spiral shell helps protect the snail's soft body.
parts.help: Find the large spiral on the snail's back. Tap it or its green marker.

parts.label: Tentacles
parts.fact: The tentacles help a snail sense the world around it.
parts.help: Find the long feelers on the snail's head. Tap them or their green marker.

parts.label: Foot
parts.fact: A snail glides on one broad, muscular foot underneath its body.
parts.help: Find the broad part touching the ground. Tap it or its green marker.

quiz.prompt: What protects the snail's soft body?
quiz.success: The hard shell helps protect its soft body.

quiz.prompt: What helps a snail sense its surroundings?
quiz.success: The tentacles are the feelers on its head.
A snail glides along on its broad foot.

quiz.prompt: Which path did our garden snail choose?
quiz.success: Garden snails are often active in damp places.

quiz.prompt: How many crawl steps reached the leaf?
quiz.success: We counted five crawl steps in our game.
